items.title: sprint.json retains completed status after sprint finishes
items.intent: After any sprint completes (pass or fail), sprint.json must be reset to idle state so subsequent runs start clean and status commands reflect reality. A stale completed or failed status in sprint.json must never persist between sprints.
steps: In the orchestrator (.aishore/aishore), locate where sprint completion is finalized (after archive write and merge/no-merge path)
After the sprint is fully archived, write {"status": "idle"} to backlog/sprint.json
Ensure this happens in both the pass path and fail path so no residual status persists

acceptanceCriteria.text: sprint.json shows idle status after a sprint completes

items.groomingNotes: Fixed in commit 56596bf — added reset_sprint call at end of _handle_sprint_success. AC verified passing.
